newsitem.title: USA: Starbucks eyes 325 new U.S. stores in '97.
newsitem.headline: Starbucks eyes 325 new U.S. stores in '97.

text.p: Starbucks Coffee Co said Thursday it plans to open at least 325 new stores in North America during fiscal 1997.

In the latest second quarter, the company opened 165 retail stores, including stores in the new markets of Ottawa; Calgary; Salt Lake City; Phoenix; Miami; Detroit; Buffalo; and Milwaukee. It ended the period with 1,094 company-operated retail stores.

Also in the second quarter, Starbucks licencees opened eight new stores in continental North America, bringing the total number of licensed stores in North America to 83. Licensees also opened six retail stores in the Pacific Rim including locations in Honolulu and Singapore.
